Director / VP / Head of Product | Principal Consultant | Capital Markets & BFSI 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
ViewTrade International IFSC | Senior Product Manager / Functional Transformation Lead 2025 Spearheaded middle and back-office transformation for a licensed GIFT City brokerage, redesigning trade operations workflows and delivering a rule-based market-making engine with commercial impact.
Aug 2025 – Nov
Redesigned middle/back-office workflows, improving operational efficiency by ~20% through automation of confirmations and account statements.
Architected a rule-based market-making engine and defined the commercial strategy — projected to generate $100K–$300K in monthly recurring revenue.
Automated client reporting (trade confirmations, account statements), reducing manual effort by 15–20% and improving accuracy.
Partnered with Compliance and Operations to streamline reporting governance and materially reduce operational risk exposure.
Baton Systems (FinTech) | Product Lead – Collateral, FX & Payments Owned end-to-end product strategy for real-time domestic and cross-border payments and collateral workflows at a high-growth post-trade FinTech. Drove product-market fit, client delivery, and revenue enablement.
May 2024 – Jun 2025
Defined and owned the product roadmap and backlog for payments (domestic/cross-border) and collateral management capabilities; governed BRD/FSD/FRS and acceptance criteria.
Delivered a Management Dashboard & Analytics platform for Tier-1 institutional clients, achieving 40– 60% improvement in operational efficiency and KPI transparency.
Conducted competitive and market analysis to identify product gaps and revenue opportunities aligned to organizational OKRs.
Enabled pre-sales pipeline by leading product demonstrations and client workshops, translating complex domain workflows into compelling business value propositions.
Mentored product managers and analysts; improved delivery predictability and cross-functional stakeholder alignment.
Capgemini (Client: UBS) | Business Analyst Lead Manager / Consulting Lead – Capital Markets Sep 2021 – May 2024 Acted as consulting Lead BA and de-facto Product Owner for UBS's global reference data and derivatives platform, managing regulatory migrations, delivery governance, and MD-level stakeholder relationships.
Owned product backlog prioritization and sprint planning across derivatives, FX, and indices reference data — delivering across multiple global releases on time.
Led three major market structure migrations: Eurex Next Gen, Nasdaq Nordic platform change, and SGX-

to-NSE GIFT City — ensuring business readiness and global release execution. Implemented Agile delivery governance using Jira/Confluence, improving release velocity by ~30% and delivering full audit-ready traceability.
Served as SPOC to Managing Director–level stakeholders; drove cross-functional decisions, managed program risks, and aligned globally dispersed teams.
Conducted regulatory impact analysis and translated regulatory change into actionable product requirements and delivery plans.
63 Moons Technologies | Business Analyst Manager – Trading & Post-Trade Products Sep 2018 – Sep 2021 Led consulting, product discovery, and delivery for capital markets software platforms deployed at banks and financial institutions across India.
Authored BRD/FRS documentation and translated regulatory mandates (clearing interoperability, commodity risk) into scalable product features.
Built securities lending and collateral modules for Tier-1 institutional clients including Standard Chartered and HDFC; supported pre-sales demonstrations.
Partnered with engineering teams end-to-end across SDLC, functional testing, UAT, and production rollout.
Led regulatory change initiatives including CCP interoperability and commodity segment risk management changes, ensuring platform compliance and market readiness.
Nomura | Deutsche Bank | State Street | Wipro BPO | Investment Banking & Global Markets
Operations Aug 2006 – Jul 2016 Delivered front-to-back post-trade operations across Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives, Repos, Securities Lending, and Custody for global financial institutions.
Managed and led teams supporting Trade & Settlement activities, Custody Operations, Reconciliation (nostro/depository), Fails management, Cash Management and operational reporting across global markets desks for Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives and Mutual Funds.
Oversaw risk management processes and compliance with key performance and risk indicators. – Built Prime Brokerage and Emerging Markets settlements capability for Nomura India; managed BAU delivery, controls, and client satisfaction.

Identified and implemented process improvements and cost-saving measures, resulting in documented savings of $100K. Drove automation and process re-engineering, saving ~6 hours daily effort in FX/SWIFT reconciliation workflows.
Key contributor to the successful implementation of the T2S project for European markets for Nomura India – Helped in migration and setting up of Custody operations for StateStreet Ireland to its Mumbai office.
Certifications & Training – Be10X – AI Tools & ChatGPT Workshop (2026) – Connected Manager – Capgemini × Harvard Business Publishing (2022)
